fcf_reported.page: E103 REFERENCE FIGURE -- compared against section 5's own construction and NEVER used to build one; the section 5 gate refuses if it ever reaches a basis. Annual report, Report of the Board of Directors, Cash flow and financing: 'Cash flow before cash flow from financing activities in the financial year was EUR 31.6 million (26.8).' NAMED EXACTLY BECAUSE IT IS NOT CALLED FREE CASH FLOW: Marimekko publishes no line under that name. The construction is the same one Bouvet calls net free cash flow -- operating cash flow plus investing cash flow, 34.5 - 2.9 = 31.6 -- and it is NOT E34's: it deducts no share-based compensation and adds back no interest, because both interest sides are already inside its operating total. HAND-READ 2026-09-08; E103's automatic model route could not run on this host (no VSS_OPENROUTER_KEY)
